Verseghy (2000), Parametrization of peatland hydraulic properties for the Canadian Land Surface Scheme, Atmos.-Ocean, 38(1), 141-160. ci from de Vries (1963) / Farouki (1981) organic-matter solid-matrix volumetric heat capacity.
metadata.description: Hydraulic and thermal properties for organic peat soils (fibric, hemic, sapric decomposition tiers). Use alongside a mineral-soil dataset (e.g., cosby) via the composite-include mechanism.
